properties.name: East-West Transit Study
properties.status: Early study (alignment + mode screening) — no route or mode chosen yet
properties.mode: Mode not yet determined (KCATA + KC Streetcar Authority are evaluating streetcar, BRT, and other options)
properties.source: ridekc.org/planning/eastwesttransit — study area bounded by Rainbow Blvd (west), Van Brunt Blvd (east), 31st St (north), 43rd St (south); Nov 2023 materials show the corridor alignment along 39th Street and Linwood Boulevard. This dashboard's illustrative line follows 39th St east to Main St, then north on Main to Linwood before continuing east — not a straight run along 39th the whole way, since Main St is where the corridor actually meets the existing streetcar line.

properties.name: North Kansas City Extension
properties.status: Early study — comparing track configurations, station locations, and turnback points
properties.source: kcstreetcar.org — study area from River Market across the Missouri River to ~32nd Ave in North Kansas City, bounded west by the ASB Railroad Bridge/BNSF right-of-way, east by Charlotte and Swift Streets.

properties.name: North Kansas City Extension — illustrative alignment
18th & Vine Jazz District Extension
properties.status: Feasibility study — comparing route options (public open house held July 2026)
properties.population_method: No formal study-area boundary has been published for this one (unlike the other two) — population is estimated within a 0.5-mile buffer of the illustrative route instead.
properties.source: kcstreetcar.org / KCTV5 coverage — proposed extension east from the existing line into the 18th & Vine corridor; specific streets not published beyond the terminus at The Paseo, route shown here follows 18th Street from the existing line east to The Paseo as the most direct plausible path.
